adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Atorvastatin inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, lowering hepatocyte cholesterol. The compensatory response is increased LDL-receptor expression and increased plasma LDL clearance.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Ezetimibe also increases hepatic LDL-receptor expression secondarily to reduced cholesterol delivery, but the stem explicitly names atorvastatin. For statins, HMG-CoA reductase inhibition lowers hepatic cholesterol and drives LDL-receptor upregulation.
